projects.name: RocksDB integrated BlobDB
projects.baselines: stock RocksDB (leveled compaction, no blob files), Titan, WiscKey
projects.lead: RocksDB's integrated key-value separation (enable_blob_files; the successor to the legacy StackableDB BlobDB), the same technique as Titan with fuller API support. Found by the Titan enricher. Find RocksDB's own published numbers (wiki 'Integrated BlobDB', RocksDB blog, db_bench results) comparing blob files on vs off for large values, with hardware, value sizes and settings.

projects.name: FastPLBF
projects.baselines: PLBF (Partitioned Learned Bloom Filter), standard Bloom filter
projects.lead: The PLBF enricher found this runnable, MIT-licensed reimplementation of PLBF by the CLBF authors, with a paper ('Fast Partitioned Learned Bloom Filter', NeurIPS 2023) claiming much faster construction than PLBF at equal memory/FPR. Report its construction-time and FPR numbers vs PLBF and Bloom with hardware.

projects.name: NNG (nanomsg-next-generation)
projects.lead: nanomsg's upstream-recommended successor (nanomsg is in sustaining mode). Look for published latency/throughput comparisons vs libzmq or nanomsg (docs, the IEEE SRDS 2025 paper that benchmarked nanomsg, issues, third-party benchmarks) and state hardware and versions; tier D if no numbers.
